authority.note: v1-faithful blessed by Gary as plain-clawd hero, 2026-08-09

invariants: It is recognizably the Anthropic pixel critter: a small coral pixel-critter mascot with a stepped/blocky silhouette (soft designed-sticker pixel energy is welcome; mushy gradients and full 3D are not).
Front-facing stepped blocky coral body with a raised head block, one small stub arm on each side of the mid-body, and four little legs below.

Two big dark eyes. Base form per the clean screenshot: open square/rounded-square eyes, each with a single small white glint. The happy closed contented arcs (two dark upturned arcs, no glints) are a legal alternate expression.

Anthropic coral palette family for the body: #DD775B with shading toward #c05f45 and highlights toward #ea9077; mono renditions use a single burnt orange (#b0512e family) or all-cream/white (#fffdf7 family).
NO angel elements: no wings, no halo, no floating heart. Those are angel-clawd.
Transparent ground on every deliverable: shot on solid chroma-green and keyed; no baked background, no drop shadow on the final PNG.

registerNeutral.medium: flat pixel-sticker illustration: a cute designed-sticker take on a pixel mascot, crisp blocky shapes on a solid chroma ground (keyed to transparent for deliverables)
registerNeutral.why: Same recorded medium exception as angel-clawd (canon/craft/pixel-mascot-medium-exception.json): merch-facing mascot art. No register anchor and no register poles on its shots; identity comes from the canonical Clawd screenshot.

relativeTo.angel-clawd: identical size to (same critter, no wings)

prose.voice: Silent. He stands, he glints, he ships.
prose.lore: The plain Anthropic pixel critter, no angel elements: the base identity that angel-clawd is derived from. PRIMARY identity reference is Gary's clean screenshot of the canonical pixel Clawd (reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-clean-screenshot.png), passed as the first input image on every shot. Rendered, like angel-clawd, as a charming designed-sticker reinterpretation via gpt-image-2, never a rigid grid port.
prose.rules: Clawd is always friendly. No angel elements ever on this entity (no wings, no halo, no floating heart): those belong to angel-clawd. No accessories in the base hero.
